about: Full-precision rank-8 LoRA on Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B: the driver adapter of the Data Goblin GDK app's self_adapter lane (github.com/MoralityLabAI/DataGoblin, gdk/). Trained on 2000 exact-oracle hill-climb decision tasks (DataGoblin bench, train split, seed 1: promotion-gate verdicts, recipe-call legality, next eligible lane), curated under split custody. Dev bench (120 tasks, dev split, seed 0; a task's digest picks its split, so no dev task was trained on), driven through the app on plain decoding: base 0.725 (87/120) -> adapter 0.983 (118/120), promoted by the lane gate (+0.258 against min_delta 0.03); DataGoblin 955cf0f, Compactification-Theory adapter-bits cdb831f6. The bench measures applying the hill-climb rules on this task family, not hill-climbing skill on live lanes.
